title: Legend of the Virgin Mary landing on Athos at Iveron

tellings.quote: she got blown on the island of Monothos and there's a monastery on the placed on the site where she supposedly landed went ashore called Iveron

plain: According to a legend told at Mount Athos, a Greek peninsula of Orthodox monasteries, the Virgin Mary was blown ashore there, and the Iveron monastery was built on the spot where she is said to have landed. Ralph Larson, presented on the show as a former CIA chief, tells this to Michels from his visit sometime between 2005 and 2007, passing on what a monk at Iveron told him.
